name: Jeeter Quad Infused Preroll | Tangie (Seasonal)
description:
Tangie is summer in its brightest form. Juicy tangerine, sweet citrus, and hints of orange marmalade create a flavor profile that feels refreshing from start to finish.

Notes of sugary citrus zest and lemon round out the experience, delivering a vibrant flavor that naturally complements carefree days and laid-back nights. Whether you're by the water, on the move, or simply enjoying the moment, Tangie is the essential companion for keeping things light, upbeat, and unmistakably summer.
